verdict: Ads ran and converted, but a tracking gap means leads aren't landing in your pipeline.
narrative: Google Ads recorded 11 conversions on $1,016.18 in spend over the last 28 days, but a system error is preventing those contacts from reaching your CRM — so your pipeline shows zero leads despite real activity. Ad spend was intentionally pulled back this week to $19.43 per day while that intake gap is resolved; scaling back up is being held until intake ownership is confirmed by August 31. On the organic side, your Google Business Profile generated 110 actions this period — including 24 calls and 56 direction requests — though profile activity softened in the final days of the window. Once the CRM connection is repaired and intake ownership is in place, the plan is to restore full spend and layer in heating campaigns starting October 1.

watch_item.issue: Google Ads conversions are not reaching your CRM, making it impossible to track or follow up on leads.
watch_item.fix: The connection between ads and your contact system is being repaired now; intake ownership is being confirmed by August 31, which also unlocks the scale-up.
